results.title: Dippr: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt | Product Hunt
results.content:
So we built Dippr, a complete data platform reimagined for agents, served to them with one prompt.  
  
- Dippr connects to all your sources and tools, and agents query across them at once, on our own federated query engine.  
  
- You set permissions per agent, even when the person using it has no login to the source, so each agent sees only what it should. [...] - Drop in your .md files and Dippr builds the semantic layer, ontology and golden questions from them, so the numbers match in everything anyone builds.  
  
- Automations let your agents run things on a schedule with fresh data.  
  
- A hosting layer runs and versions everything your agents build, with the rules in one place and every query logged. [...] We’ve spent years working on data infrastructure, and this is the first time we’ve seen the person who needs the answer also be the person who can build the tool. Dippr is our bet on what the data platform looks like when that’s true: query your data where it lives, give agents only the access their user has, keep one definition of every metric, and host whatever gets built.  
  
If your team is already letting agents touch company data, tell us how you’re doing it today and where it breaks.
